name: Beeswax
description: HONEYMOON field agent: press the button, show Beeswax a flower, hear the verdict in your ear.

permissions.description: Takes one photo when you press the glasses button, so Beeswax can judge what you're holding. Photos are never saved.
Hears what you say about the thing you scan, and your plea to the bees.

hardwareRequirements.description: Hears the scout and the plea.
Short press scans, long press replays the last line.
Amber while scanning, green or red for the verdict.
